tools.name: list_cities
tools.description: Lists the US cities djbnb covers, each with its slug and the links to its tonight and this weekend pages. Use the slug with whos_playing.

tools.name: whos_playing
tools.description: Lists the announced DJ nights in one djbnb city tonight or this weekend: time, night, venue, door price when known, and the DJs on the bill, each with its djbnb link. Start times are local to the city.
